_what: Posts (pieces-screen.tsx): the pieces each pursuit is making, read from that pursuit's own database. A pursuit's database is any connection the vault names with `database_suffix` (secrets:names at the account's door), so a new pursuit shows here with no change; one whose database has no `table` shows nothing. `columns` are read by `tool`; `order` is the stages in the order a piece is shown (a stage not named comes after them). `ask_first` stages are the ones waiting on the person. A piece's slides are its `script` when that is a list of slides ([{head, body}]) or pages ({pages: [{sections: [{h, b}]}]}); its pictures are the files `extra.files` names, read through the files owner; a file kept only as a path on one computer cannot be read here and says so.
